fields.Name: IT107 - Agent Pre-Execution RAG Permission Gate
fields.Description: Pre-execution RAG's scope-permission gate, deterministic, no LLM: the checks call AgentPreExecutionRAG.Execute() directly as IT: Search Agent over a sentinel MJ: AI Agent Notes corpus seeded in IT: Integration Test Scope (shared fixture lifecycle with IT62). RG1: for the run user (granted Search on the IT scope through the UI, Developer or Integration role) the result holds the seeded in-scope notes, not the IT-SCOPE-EXCLUDED one, and no Forbidden row is written. RG2: for an unsaved copy of the agent set to SearchScopeAccess='None' the result is null and exactly one Forbidden MJ: Search Execution Logs row is written for the IT scope and the query, attributed to the agent. 2 checks RG1-RG2.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A granted run of pre-execution RAG retrieves the seeded in-scope notes; a refused run retrieves nothing and leaves exactly one Forbidden search-log row naming the IT scope, the query and the agent.
